title: Orchestrator on FactorySandbox; per-run image pin; prune protects pinned digests
description: Run record stores the image ref at submit (read via a DO method from ctx.container.images); every container of the run starts on it; fallback: deploy stages recent digests as named images. Image off cloudflare/sandbox base. prune.go skips digests pinned by live runs.
acceptance_criteria: tests for pin + prune protection; orchestrator container run works
